name: palisade
description: Inspect and fix email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, BIMI) with Palisade: the MCP server as a stdio bridge, and a skill saying when and how to use it.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and fix SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS and BIMI for your domains.
interface.longDescription: Palisade is an agentic DMARC platform for IT teams and MSPs. Audit any domain's email authentication, read DMARC reports, diagnose SPF and DKIM issues, and move a domain to p=reject with a person approving each write. Sign in with OAuth; auditing a domain you don't own needs no account.
defaultPrompt: Audit example.com's SPF, DKIM and DMARC and explain what's failing.
Get the DNS records I need to publish to fix DMARC for our domain.
Summarize last week's DMARC reports and which sources are failing alignment.
